articles.summary: For Educato, Y Combinator was a truly unique experience that allowed us to 10x our business in just 3 months. On top of that, we had the opportunity to meet visionary startups committed to transforming all areas of society. However, one thing we noticed is rare VC-backed edTech startups. Educato was the only Education company in our YC batch and to our knowledge, we are the only ex-Palantir Education startup. So today we wanted to highlight some of our favorite fellow YC companies building in the Education and career improvement space. We want to share some of our favorite companies from recent YC cohorts—Univerbal, UPchieve, Hiration, and Avocademy—who inspire us with their unique products.
articles.title: Our Favorite YC Startups Shaping Education and Career Building
